risks.title: Risks related to economic conditions and financial market volatility
risks.score_rationale: Financial market conditions directly affect investment performance and claims liabilities. Volatility in equity and credit markets impacts net investment income and the value of separate accounts and retirement products.

risks.title: Interest rate risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates directly impact investment income, spread margins, future benefit reserves, and the value of the fixed investment portfolio. Low rates reduce income while high rates can drive accelerated policy withdrawals.

risks.title: Credit and counterparty risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to default risk from bond issuers and loans in its investment portfolio. Credit losses can negatively impact net investment income.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict insurance industry regulations, including risk-based capital requirements (NAIC). Regulatory changes could affect capital requirements and profitability.

risks.title: Liquidity risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet 12-month operational needs (claims payments, expenses, interest). Catastrophic events or rating downgrades could constrain liquidity.

risks.title: Geopolitical and pricing risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions and tariff policies can increase claims costs, investment portfolio volatility, and influence pricing strategies and capital management.
